fusions.name: Headsman's Due
fusions.desc: A two-handed downward cut that deals 26 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Felling Arc
fusions.desc: A hewing swing that deals 28 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Top-Heavy Balance
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Parted Mail
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
